title: Oriented Cuvette Queue Load
brief: Load a dry practice cuvette into a keyed orientation cassette for the instrument queue; no instrument reading is simulated.

migration.legacyLearningObjective: Program an oriented cuvette handling sequence and distinguish the configured instrument-ready state from learner-recorded evidence.
migration.redesignRationale: The legacy instrument reading and post-read removal cannot be validated without inventing instrument measurement behavior. This successor preserves oriented cuvette handling as dry-practice loading into a keyed queue cassette and excludes the unsupported read.
